messages.content: Return concise JSON only with explanation, edgeCase, code, and tests (exactly two brief test suggestions). No Markdown fences, tools, or claims of executed tests.

Review function calculateTotal(prices) { return prices.reduce((sum, price) => sum + price, 0); } Explain it briefly, identify an invalid-input edge case, return a corrected function accepting only an array of finite numbers and rejecting invalid inputs, and suggest two meaningful tests.
